# Consul Connect MCP Gateway

Command: `consul connect mcp-gateway`

<EnterpriseAlert />

The `connect mcp-gateway` command starts the `consul-mcp-gateway` process for a [Consul Agentic Runtime Fabric](/consul/docs/agentic-mesh) AI agent. The process is the external processor that the agent's Envoy proxy uses for [MCP tool access](/consul/docs/agentic-mesh/mcp-sidecar).

The command runs the `consul-mcp-gateway` binary from `/app/consul-mcp-gateway` by default. It passes the `-addr` and `-log-level` values to the binary, connects the binary to its own standard input, output, and error, and sends `SIGTERM` to the binary when the command shuts down.

<!-- TODO: Confirm with the product owner whether operators run this command directly outside Kubernetes in Consul 2.1. The command help says that it verifies the target service has the ai-agent role, but the v2.1.0+ent implementation does not perform that lookup. -->

## Examples

The following command starts the MCP gateway with its external processor server listening on the default address.

```shell-session
$ consul connect mcp-gateway -addr 127.0.0.1:21101
```

The following command starts an MCP gateway binary installed at a custom path and logs at the debug level.

```shell-session
$ consul connect mcp-gateway -gateway-binary /usr/local/bin/consul-mcp-gateway -log-level DEBUG
```

## Usage

Usage: `consul connect mcp-gateway [options]`

#### Command Options

- `-addr=<address>` - TCP address for the external processor server of the MCP gateway. The command passes this value to `consul-mcp-gateway`. Default is `127.0.0.1:21101`.

- `-gateway-binary=<path>` - Path to the `consul-mcp-gateway` binary. Default is `/app/consul-mcp-gateway`. The command exits with an error when no binary exists at the path.

- `-log-json` - Output this command's logs in JSON format. Default is `false`.

- `-log-level=<level>` - Specifies the log level. The command passes the value to `consul-mcp-gateway` in lowercase. Default is `INFO`.
